note: The demo's bench (GAME_SPEC §17). Every item is a cell of the one closed world; each vessel starts open to the room, full of air. loss: W/K to the room, for what is not glassware (glassware loses by its own glass's outside: GAME_SPEC §6, Stage 53). wall_g: the wall's mass, which holds heat; glassware: what it is made as (data/glassware.json: its standard's shape, its capacity to the brim, its wall and floor; GAME_SPEC §12.3); without one (the condenser), wall_mm and floor_mm give its wall and floor and it is a cylinder of its volume. A burner's conductance is with its valve fully open. at: [column, row], the top-left square of its footprint on the bench's grid of squares; an item without it starts in the cabinet. The bench adds its own tray, where what overflows goes.
